verdict.rationale: `ultrametric init` writes the same skill to both Codex (`.agents/skills`) and Claude Code (`.claude/skills`), confirmed by a hands-on dry run. Any other host can only attach the generic remote MCP server, and the same account and records carry across connections. Missing for 10: per-harness install instructions for Cursor and other agents beyond Codex and Claude Code, and a documented per-harness install guide (the evidence shows only generic MCP connection steps).
